# pidginhost_packages (Data Source)

Server packages (sizes) available for new servers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_packages" "gen2" {
  generation = "gen2"
}

locals {
  # First package with at least 4 GB of memory.
  small = [for p in data.pidginhost_packages.gen2.packages : p if p.memory >= 4][0]
}

output "package_slug" {
  value = local.small.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `generation` (String) Only list packages available on this hardware generation (its slug). Free tier packages are left out when the generation is not free tier eligible.

### Read-Only

- `packages` (Attributes List) Every matching package. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packages))

<a id="nestedatt--packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packages`

Read-Only:

- `available_generations` (List of String) Slugs of the hardware generations that offer the package.
- `cpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
- `disk_size` (Number) Disk size, in GB.
- `id` (String) Package id.
- `memory` (Number) Memory, in GB.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Short name of the package, accepted wherever a package is selected.
- `traffic` (Number) Included monthly traffic, in TB.
